## File: facebookresearch_fairseq2/tests/common.py

Prompts

```
['test two PyTorch tensors are element-wise equal within a specified tolerance', 'test two PyTorch tensors are exactly element-wise equal with zero tolerance', 'test a PyTorch tensor has no positive or negative infinite elements', 'test a PyTorch tensor has no NaN elements', 'test setting a temporary manual seed on RNGs for specific devices']
```

Usage

```
{'test_assert_close': 'test two PyTorch tensors are element-wise equal within a specified tolerance', 'test_assert_equal': 'test two PyTorch tensors are exactly element-wise equal with zero tolerance', 'test_has_no_inf': 'test a PyTorch tensor has no positive or negative infinite elements', 'test_has_no_nan': 'test a PyTorch tensor has no NaN elements', 'test_temporary_manual_seed': 'test setting a temporary manual seed on RNGs for specific devices'}
```
